correctness.rationale: Exact binomial iterate identities give a positive weighted-shift Jensen gap; a second-order exponential expansion gives fixed-iteration asymptotic \(k/(32n^4)\). Centered binomial variance gives uniform \(k^{-3}\) degree profile, while Efron–Stein plus Chernoff delivers a summable global domination. Thus the stated if-and-only-if Schatten threshold, exact all-p integral and operator-norm limit follow by infinite-dimensional estimates, not finite computation. The packaged checker passed 180 rational identities, 108 finite iteration identities and 66 numerical sanity tests.

value.rationale: The comparison resolves a natural spectral regularity question for two well-established nonlinear transform dynamics of canonical 2-isometric shifts: individually neither orbit is a trace-class perturbation of the isometric shift, yet their difference has exactly fourth-order singular decay, a sharp \(p=1/4\) boundary and universal scaling constants. The complete singular-weight profile and all-p mass law are substantially more informative than one-step mean inequalities.
